messages:
Sam Wu: Heads-up — PoshCare renewal conversation. They want a 9mo term, net30 billing, and to keep Dedicated capacity. PO pending from procurement. Need pricing confirmation and legal signoff on a couple redlines. @Priya Rao can you coordinate? :eyes:
Priya Rao: Thanks — need final seat count and whether the Dedicated add-on stays. Current quote shows 120 seats and Dedicated + burst. Do we have updated usage?
Sam Wu: They actually trimmed to 95 seats after Q review. Still want Dedicated. I uploaded the amended SOW here: https://files.redwood/poshcare/sow-v2.pdf
Jordan Kim: FYI Dedicated activation needs ~2 weeks lead time. If they expect service by 2026-04-15, we need signed PO by 2026-04-01 to hit that. :calendar:
Marta Flores: Pricing team OK on per-token rate if seat count reduced, but finance needs controller signoff for Net30. Can we ask for a 1-month upfront invoice as backup? If not, I can escalate to enable Net30.
Liam Chen: Quick legal check — SOW has client-requested data residency language and a lowered indemnity cap. Our default cap is standard; I'd prefer 12mo for the raised cap, otherwise need exec approval to accept on 9mo.
Priya Rao: The customer is firm on 9mo; they asked if we can do a small concession. Proposed offering: 9mo term at 2% one-time discount if PO received by 2026-03-30. Thoughts?
Sam Wu: Sounds pragmatic. Also procurement says PO will reference AP-33890 and requires our vendor code. They plan to e-sign via DocuSign. I'm going to loop in billing.
Jordan Kim: Operationally we can schedule Dedicated pool to start 2026-04-16 if docu-sign happens by 2026-04-01. That gives one day for infra prep.
Marta Flores: If they send PO now, route to billing@redwood.com for vendor code. I'll prep the vendor-code request template and cc finance.
Sam Wu: PO details from the customer (copied from their procurement note):

```
PO: AP-33890
Amount: $85,500
Term: 9 months (2026-04-15 to 2027-01-15)
Billing: Net30
Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Vendor code requested: yes
```

Sam Wu: Also they asked that we leave pricing unchanged aside from the conditional discount. Priya can you confirm we accept the 2% conditional discount and that legal redlines are the only blockers?
Priya Rao: Confirming — we accept the 2% discount conditional on PO by 2026-03-30 and no additional commercial changes. I'll send the signed quote with acceptance language and attach legal redlines for quick review.
Liam Chen: If the client refuses to accept our indemnity cap, escalate to CRO. If they accept redline as-is, legal can sign off same day.
DocuSign-Bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelope_id=0xabc12345, sent to client procurement (procurement@poshcare.com). Status: sent.
Sam Wu: Great. I'll follow up with procurement and confirm expected sign date. Priya — keep me posted on client legal; Marta will route billing once PO lands. :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: Will do. I'll ping once client legal confirms; aiming to close this week.
Liam Chen: One more note — add standard cross-border data clause from our library if they insist on EU residency language; that should mitigate the legal exposure.
Marta Flores: Received. I'll prepare pro-forma invoice once PO is in and push vendor-code request.
Sam Wu: Thanks everyone — action items: Priya to secure PO + legal acceptance; Marta to prep billing/vcode; Jordan to schedule activation window after sign; Liam to standby for legal final.
Priya Rao: Copy. Updating the quote now and will post the signed pdf here when done.
